claims.text: The hotel has 362 rooms and suites.

findings.quote: our 362 rooms and suites offer a sublime blend of comfort and design.

claims.text: The hotel is located on the banks of the Huangpu River.

findings.quote: Located on the banks of the Huangpu River, Mandarin Oriental Pudong, Shanghai offers the perfect combination of style, comfort and world-class service.

claims.text: Yong Yi Ting serves Hangzhou cuisine.

findings.quote: Under Consultant Chef Fu Yue Liang's leadership, Yong Yi Ting has embraced both the essence of Hangzhou cuisine and the culinary sentiment in this region, infusing them with modern techniques and innovation to elevate exquisite specialties.

claims.text: Fifty 8° Grill is a modern grill restaurant.

findings.quote: Fifty 8° Grill is our esteemed modern grill restaurant. We use only the freshest ingredients and employ exceptional kitchen craftsmanship to offer a dining experience that’s truly exceptional.

claims.text: Zest is an all-day dining restaurant specialising in Asian and International cuisine.

findings.quote: Our all-day dining restaurant specialises in Asian and International cuisine served in a stylish, modern setting.

claims.text: Qi Bar is on the lobby level of the hotel.

findings.quote: With a stunning design, top mixologists and some of the city’s best DJs, Qi Bar on the lobby level of the hotel is the place to be in Shanghai after dark.

claims.text: Riviera Lounge serves Afternoon Tea.

findings.quote: Offering a respite from the hustle and bustle of busy city life, this calm oasis is where guests can enjoy a leisurely drink, a light bite or our famous Afternoon Tea.

claims.text: The Mandarin Cake Shop serves pastries, chocolates, breads and cakes.

findings.quote: Serving a wide variety of freshly baked, homemade delicacies including pastries, chocolates, breads and cakes, The Mandarin Cake Shop on the lobby level of the Executive Apartments is a must-stop for anyone looking to indulge.

claims.text: The hotel has a 25-metre indoor swimming pool.

findings.quote: A spectacular 25-metre indoor Swimming Pool with Vitality Pool and Children’s Pool is available to guests and residents around the clock.

claims.text: The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours to hotel guests.

findings.note: Fitness Centre 24 hours for hotel guests (label Fitness Centre: on preceding line)

findings.quote: 24-Hour Fitness Centre | Mandarin Oriental Pudong, Shanghai

claims.text: The Spa covers 2,415 sqm.

findings.quote: Covering 2,415 sqm, The Spa features 13 exclusive single, couple, and VIP Suites, each with a private dressing room, en suite, and steam shower.

claims.text: Yong Yi Ting has been awarded one Michelin star since the inaugural Michelin Guide 2017 for Shanghai.

findings.quote: Award winning Chinese restaurant, Yong Yi Ting has been awarded one Michelin star since the inaugural Michelin Guide 2017 for Shanghai, the first-ever Michelin Restaurant Guide in mainland China.

claims.text: The Spa features 13 exclusive single, couple, and VIP Suites.

claims.text: Four spa suites offer private vitality pools overlooking the garden.

findings.quote: Four suites offer additional luxury with private vitality pools overlooking the garden.
